summary: @servicetitan/temporal-lite preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscated script (`_0xXXXX` identifiers, per-function string-property maps disguising execFileSync/https.get/chmod/OS-fingerprint calls) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {cwd: D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated blob (shuffled string/opcode array, rotate-array decoder `WV8StW`, `_0xXXXX` naming) that is shipped in the tarball but not listed in `package.json` `files` (which only declares dist/ and src/) and has no relation to the advertised purpose of the package (a Temporal date/time polyfill wrapping luxon). The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute a payload that Node-based tooling would not naturally trace. Behavior fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
